text: Which accounting concept requires that a business transaction is recorded separately from the personal affairs of its owner?
explanation: The business entity concept dictates that the financial activities of the business entity must be kept strictly separate from the personal finances of the proprietor.

text: What is the accounting effect of purchasing inventory on credit?
optionA: Increase in inventory asset and increase in trade payables liability
optionB: Increase in inventory and decrease in cash
optionC: Increase in expense and decrease in capital
optionD: Decrease in trade payables and decrease in cash
explanation: Purchasing inventory on credit debits Purchases (Asset/Expense) and credits Trade Payables (Liability).

text: Under an imprest petty cash system, what does the reimbursement check restore?
optionA: The petty cash balance back to the agreed fixed float
optionC: The general ledger cash book total
explanation: The reimbursement reimburses the exact vouchers spent to return petty cash to its predetermined float.
